aboutBody: Behind every business is someone trying to keep everything moving. Paper Trail brings structure to the financial records, with bookkeeping repair and monthly support that helps the numbers make sense.
aboutClosing: Useful records. Clear explanations. A little more room to focus.
blogPreview0: Overdue bookkeeping starts with identifying missing records and the last completed month. See how statements, receipts, and reconciliations fit into a catch up plan.
blogPreview1: Profit and cash flow describe different parts of your business finances. Learn why unpaid invoices, bills, and timing can leave a profitable business short of cash.
blogPreview2: Organized books help your tax preparer trace income, expenses, and account balances. Review the reports and supporting records to gather before the tax handoff.
